name: Khulna

queries.query: Khulna City Corporation official cadastral map parcel land records GIS
queries.scope: Find city-specific official registration/map sources and determine whether anonymous parcel geometry is documented.
queries.result: KCC publishes a general city-map page; KDA advertises a mouza/dag-based Detailed Area Plan, which is planning evidence rather than a verified land-title register. Direct HTML retrieval for the .gov.bd map sites failed normal TLS certificate validation; no certificate bypass was used. The national DLRS portal was not tied to a particular map sheet covering the exact ranked point. Registry source status therefore remains undetermined, and no parcel geometry/schema was verified.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English and local-language web searches; official source page review; bounded anonymous HTML review where available.
